Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; BAKKEN MUSEUM. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Bakken Museum.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; BAKKEN MUSEUM.

$150,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $150,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Bakken Museum for interactive exhibits and outreach programs on arts and cultural heritage.
additions: $150,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $150,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Bakken Museum for interactive exhibits and outreach programs on arts and cultural heritage.
